line: A chain of hands from you to a stranger: tested with letters in 1967, explained by rings that outgrow the Earth, closed around the globe.
line_cn: 从你到一个陌生人，一串手拉起来：1967 年用信验证，一圈圈的人算到超过地球，最后围着地球合上。

camera.expresses: rules being set up; reading time
camera.serves: a question; a demonstration; a verdict
one chain → many chains; one person → a crowd

camera.expresses: a jump to another place or time
camera.serves: diving into a head, a node, a ring
a line bending into an arc, a row into a ring

transitions: Cut on a beat or move through something;
no page turns, no wipes, no zoom-blur.
labels: One geometric sans for everything Latin (e.g. Jost, OFL): titles 600 at 84–92 px with tight tracking (−2), big numbers 600 at 44–150 px, small caps labels 500 at 20–22 px with +3 tracking. A CJK sans (e.g. Noto Sans SC, OFL, subset to the characters used) for Chinese, ≥ 34 px on screen.
Left-aligned, flush to a 124 px margin; no header bars, no centred stacks. The one exception is type inside a closed shape (a ring, a globe), which centres in it.
Hierarchy: one big statement or number, one line saying what it means, one small source line. A question can sit left and its answer right on the same baseline.
Arrival: type slides up 12–22 px while fading in over ~0.4 s, staggered by line; it leaves by fading. Big numbers slide further.
motion: 60 fps. Figures never jump: every pose change goes through damped springs (hip fast, upper arm medium, forearm slower, head loosest) so forearms arrive late and overshoot slightly. Integrate at a fixed step from a pre-roll so renders repeat exactly.
Anticipation first: dip before a jump, pull the hand back before reaching. Keep crouches shallow (≤ 0.02 of height) or the legs bow into brackets.
Pop-in: a figure grows out of the ground with a spring step (≈ 20 % overshoot), its line weight growing with it.
Clasp: on contact the clasp point rebounds once and both bodies are tugged towards each other, then settle.

native_moves.name: Join the hands
native_moves.does: Two people reach, clasp, and become one curve.
native_moves.fits: a friendship; a trade; a handshake deal; a contract.

native_moves.name: The chain
native_moves.does: People pop up between two ends and clasp one by one, faster and faster, until the line is closed; then the accent runs end to end.
native_moves.fits: supply chains; a relay of messages; a family tree line; steps of a proof.

native_moves.name: The ripple
native_moves.does: One figure changes (dips, jumps, turns accent); a pulse runs along the ground line and each person reacts as it reaches them; finally all turn to the source.
native_moves.fits: a rumour; a bank run; a traffic jam; a market panic.

native_moves.name: Let go
native_moves.does: The reverse of a clasp: a hand drops, the arm swings back, what was carried falls and greys.
native_moves.fits: a broken link; a lost message; a failed handover.

native_moves.name: Rings
native_moves.does: People stand on a circle, feet in, heads out, and close it hand in hand; rings nest, each a constant factor larger, under a fractal pull-back.
native_moves.fits: compounding; generations; viral spread; orders of magnitude.

native_moves.name: The bar chart of people
native_moves.does: Chains whose lengths are the data; a fractional value is a last link drawn shorter.
native_moves.fits: degrees of separation; queue lengths; steps in a process; ranking.

native_moves.name: The whole shape
native_moves.does: A line bends onto an arc and grows around a globe or a closed form until the last two hands meet.
native_moves.fits: "everyone"; a closed loop economy; a cycle; a finale.

score.note: small, light, pitched sounds that follow the hands
